items.label: l'anesthésie
items.scene: Under ANAESTHESIA a sleepy bear snores 'ZZZ' ("-ZEE") through his paw operation, dreaming of honey.

items.label: la récupération
items.scene: A bear in a dressing gown does slow RECOVERY ("ray-kew-pay-rah-SYOHN") exercises, lifting a teaCUP like a dumbbell.

items.label: l'interruption
items.scene: A duck waddles in quacking, an INTERRUPTION ("an-teh-rewp-SYOHN") right in the middle of the doctor's round.

items.label: la dérision
items.scene: A pompous crow tries to sing at a bedside and two parrots hoot with DERISION ("day-ree-ZYOHN").

items.label: l'infirmerie
items.scene: IN FEAR ("an-feer-muh-REE"), little MARY carries her teddy to the INFIRMARY bed, where a nurse bandages its paw.

items.label: le/la vétérinaire
items.scene: VET TERRY ("vay-tay-ree-NEHR") leans NEAR a nervous hamster in a tiny bed, listening with a tiny stethoscope.

items.label: le chevet
items.scene: A BEDSIDE table shaped like a little red CHEVY car ("shuh-VEH") stands by a bed, a glass of water on its bonnet.
